textProposal.reviewNotice: This text is a starting point, not legal advice. It must be reviewed by the data protection officer or a lawyer before publication. Replace every "[To complete: …]" marker with your organisation's own information.

wizard.title: Setup
wizard.intro: Follow the list below to configure the entity. Deposits stay closed to the public until the setup is complete.
wizard.introActive: The setup is complete: the entity is open. The list below is shown for information.
wizard.setupBanner: This entity is being set up: deposits are closed to the public.
wizard.reviewedHint: Tick this box once the mail templates are reviewed or adapted; it is recorded when the setup is completed.
wizard.completed: The setup is complete: the entity is open for deposits.
wizard.canCompleteNo: Required steps remain to be done before the entity can be opened:
wizard.incompleteText: These required steps are not done:
wizard.alreadyComplete: The setup of this entity is already complete.
wizard.forbidden: You are not allowed to force the opening of this entity.

force.hint: Super admin only: opens the entity even if required steps are not done.
force.title: Force the opening of the entity?
force.text: Deposits will become possible while required steps are not done: the entity could send incomplete mails or show incomplete texts. This action is recorded in the audit log.

wizard.backLabel: Return to the setup list of the entity
wizard.error: The setup could not be loaded.

branding_logo.label: Logo
branding_logo.hint: The logo shown at the top of the public pages and in mails.

branding_colors.label: Colours
branding_colors.hint: Main colour and accent colour, with a contrast check.

smtp.label: Mail (SMTP)
smtp.hint: The server sending the entity's mails; try it with the test send button.

internal_networks.label: Internal IP ranges
internal_networks.hint: The networks from which a user is recognised as internal.

internal_domains.label: Internal mail domains
internal_domains.hint: The domains of the addresses of internal users.

legal_notice.label: Legal notice
legal_notice.hint: Text to review; the step is done once no "[To complete: …]" marker remains.

privacy_policy.label: Privacy policy
privacy_policy.hint: Text to review; the step is done once no "[To complete: …]" marker remains.

mail_templates.label: Mail templates
mail_templates.hint: Review the default templates or adapt them, then tick the box below.

home.title: Setup to complete
home.text: The entity {name} is being set up: configure it to open it for deposits.
home.textMany: These entities are being set up: configure them to open them for deposits.

legalProposal.error: The proposed text could not be loaded.
legalProposal.loaded: The proposed text is in the editor. Review it, complete it, then save.

confirm.title: Replace the current text?
confirm.text: The editor already contains text. The proposed text will replace it (nothing is saved until you save).

legalProposal.markers: {count} "To complete" marker remains in the text. The step counts as done only when none remains.
legalProposal.markersMany: {count} "To complete" markers remain in the text. The step counts as done only when none remains.
legalProposal.hint: The setup step only considers the text in the entity's default language; it counts as done only when that text contains no "[To complete: …]" (or "[À compléter : …]") marker.
